---
name: 🧑‍🏫 Tutorial Task
about: A task that includes both implementation and tutorial/documentation for onboarding
title: "[Tutorial] <short description here>"
labels: ["tutorial", "role:docs"]
assignees: []

---

## 🧠 Goal
Describe what this tutorial aims to teach or accomplish.

## 🔧 Technical Steps
- [ ] Describe technical tasks required (code, Unity setup, etc.)
- [ ] Break down complex parts into smaller bullets
- [ ] Include any validations, requirements, or dependencies

## 📝 Documentation Deliverables
- [ ] Create a Markdown tutorial (e.g. `/docs/unity/...`)
- [ ] Add screenshots or visuals if useful
- [ ] Include Unity steps, C# snippets, expected output

## 🔀 Git Tutorial Checkpoints

| Stage       | Commit Description                    | Git Ref (to fill in later) |
|-------------|----------------------------------------|-----------------------------|
| 🟢 Start    | Project setup before changes           | `replace-this`              |
| ✅ Complete | Final version with tutorial completed  | `replace-this`              |

> Please create both commits before merging and link them here so others can easily `git checkout` both.

## 🔖 Labels
Please assign additional labels such as:
- `epic_<name>`
- `role_:<role>`
- `priority_<level>`
